S-1.title: Role Injection on Create — users.createRule is public
S-1.finding: users.createRule = "" (public). The emergency_users_hardening.pb.js hook intercepts only onRecordUpdateRequest, not create. A registration POST body containing role=admin or role=superadmin may be stored as-is. This must be verified by T-INJECT-CREATE-ANON-ADMIN before any public access is permitted.
S-1.status: UNVERIFIED — requires T-INJECT-CREATE-ANON-ADMIN on isolated v0.29.3
S-1.action_required: Run emergency blocking test group on isolated instance. If role injection on create is confirmed, block publication until createRule or hook guard is applied.

S-2.title: phone_verified and is_alias_account absent from users schema
S-2.source: pb_get_schema and all migration files inspected
S-2.finding: Fields phone_verified and is_alias_account are not present in the users collection. Tests T-FIELD-PHONE-REJECT and T-FIELD-ALIAS-REJECT cannot be executed as designed. Whether production requires these fields is NEEDS-EXTERNAL.
S-2.status: SCHEMA-GAP — operator must clarify whether these fields are planned, removed, or never intended

S-3.title: Hardcoded plaintext credential in committed migration
S-3.finding: The seed migration sets email sdmadmin@ultra.works with a plaintext password visible in the migration file. If this migration was applied to production and the password was not rotated, the credential is fully exposed to anyone with repository access. The harness MUST NOT use this credential. The operator must rotate it immediately if production is affected.
S-3.status: OPERATOR ACTION REQUIRED — verify production credential is rotated; confirm migration was not applied to production database with this password intact
S-3.harness_note: The harness creates all test credentials via openssl rand. It never reads, uses, or references sdmadmin@ultra.works or its password. The isolated database starts fresh and this seeded user exists in isolation only for the duration of the harness run.
